model.name: Per-task MD view generation (every 📄 link resolves, no 404)
model.description: generate-sprint-md emits ONE task-<slug>.md per Task unit (title, acceptance criteria, statusChecklist, chain) so every task's 📄 MD link resolves to a real file (HTTP 200) instead of 404. Task units must NOT set model.sourceFile to planning.md - that collapses all tasks into one shared view; each task gets its own generated MD file. Fixes the Tron-visible 404 on 📄 links.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (screenshot): the 📄 task links 404. FIX: generate-sprint-md emits one task-<slug>.md per task unit so every 📄 resolves; tasks must not point sourceFile at planning.md.

discoverySource.note: taskMdHref (rb-task-detail.ts:88) uses model.sourceFile if set (=planning.md collapses all tasks to one view) ELSE /md/<dir>/<slug>.md (404 when no per-task MD emitted). Fix: generate-sprint-md emits per-task MD + tasks stop pointing sourceFile at planning.md.

model.crossRefNote: Makes the R22.1 📄 MD-link (taskMdHref, tagged R22.1 d6b29c09) actually RESOLVE - R22.1 is the link, R27.3 makes its target file EXIST. Sibling of R27.1 (statusChecklist render) in the same task-detail family.

acceptanceCriteria.text: generate-sprint-md emits ONE task-<slug>.md per Task unit (title + ACs + statusChecklist + chain), not only planning.md.
Task units do NOT set model.sourceFile to planning.md (which collapses all tasks into one shared view); each task MD is its own file.
taskMdHref (rb-task-detail.ts:88) resolves to the per-task MD -> HTTP 200, never 404 (the Tron-visible bug is gone).
The per-task MD is a generated VIEW (law #100); --check (check:sprint-md) byte-match holds for the per-task files.
Verified live: every task's 📄 link opens its own MD file.
